task.population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

model.interpretation: One fixed, assumption-completed joint law for equal-weight draws representing the declared peso_lab-weighted complete-case analytical population. This is not an estimate of that population from target data.

bmi.family: affinely transformed beta conditional on age and female

bp.residual_latent_family: two independent uniforms, centered and standardized to unit variance
bp.conditional_structure: Linear additive conditional means; residual latent variables independent of all covariates; constant conditional residual covariance.

uncertainty.interpretation: Seeds change individual draws only. Source sampling uncertainty, unidentified relationships and transport uncertainty are not represented by parameter draws.

selection_and_measurement.selection: Model the distribution conditional on the task eligibility and complete-case rules directly; do not simulate screening, laboratory weights, pregnancy, treatment or missingness.
selection_and_measurement.measurement: BMI and BP are generated as released measured variables, not latent error-free physiology. No explicit device-error or reading-aggregation model is fitted.
selection_and_measurement.transport: Assume the INTERSALT pooled BMI slopes apply to the task's age/sex-adjusted raw-scale projections, including ages 60-79, despite population, adjustment and measurement differences.
